chapter: Back to the horn: house sessions
title: The house sessions around 1950
summary: He names the regulars at his house sessions, which grew too big, including Coco, Bill Walde and Stanley Maddison.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: When did you start giving the sessions at your house?
I remember it was about 1950...yeah...we had some nice sessions out there... Oh yeah...Charlie LeConte...
Charlie LeConte used to come...yeah...I don't know what happened to him...

I don't either...well we had Coco and all them guys used to come out there...Coco the guitar player...we had Bill the bass player...we had Stanley Maddelson...used to come out there...the piano player...
Bill used to play nice bass...I got some pictures...I got a gang of pictures from those sessions...with Doc Sushant sitting on there...playing ghetto... Raymond... bamboo....
